evaluation.grid: all reference annotation timestamps inside source audio duration
evaluation.alignment: nearest predicted frame by timestamp; ties choose earlier; no timing shift optimization
evaluation.voicing: reference f0 > 0; predicted f0 > 0 and confidence >=0.82
evaluation.aggregation: micro: pooled frame counts, including detector unvoiced as incorrect on reference voiced; macro: unweighted mean of clip metrics
evaluation.octaveError: RCA correct and RPA incorrect; sign from round(cents/1200)
